mechanism: Bumetanide causes electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hyponatremia) and dehydration which may lower seizure threshold and reduce perampanel efficacy; perampanel may increase fall risk through CNS effects, compounded by bumetanide-induced orthostatic hypotension and electrolyte imbalances.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly, maintain adequate hydration, assess seizure control frequency, and implement fall precautions; consider alternative diuretics or close monitoring if combination is necessary.
